Dina Soliman  
📍 Bengaluru, India | 📧 dina.soliman@email.com | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/dina-soliman | 📞 +91 98765 43210  

At DataStrategy Consulting, I specialize in translating complex data challenges into actionable strategies for clients across industries. My work spans from designing scalable analytics pipelines to optimizing machine learning workflows, with a focus on delivering measurable business impact. Prior roles at InsightLabs Inc. and TechPulse Analytics honed my ability to bridge technical rigor with strategic decision-making. I thrive in collaborative environments where data-driven insights directly influence operational efficiency and growth.  

At DataStrategy Consulting (2022–present), I lead projects that integrate advanced analytics with business objectives. A recent initiative involved optimizing customer retention using A/B testing frameworks, which reduced churn by 12% across three client segments. I also spearheaded the implementation of MLOps pipelines using MLflow and Weights & Biases, streamlining model deployment cycles by 25%. My work with SQL analytics has enabled clients to derive actionable insights from unstructured datasets, while my expertise in Tableau and Power BI has transformed raw data into intuitive dashboards for non-technical stakeholders.  

In my role as Senior Data Scientist at InsightLabs Inc. (2021–2022), I developed a feature engineering pipeline that improved model accuracy by 18% in predictive maintenance use cases. This involved leveraging Pandas and NumPy to preprocess terabytes of sensor data, ensuring robustness in noisy environments. A key project involved building statistical models to forecast supply chain disruptions, which saved a client over $2M in inventory costs. My work with SQL analytics here enabled real-time monitoring of key performance indicators, supporting data-driven inventory adjustments.  

As a Junior Data Scientist at TechPulse Analytics (2019–2020), I contributed to projects that required deep domain knowledge and technical precision. One notable task involved creating a data visualization strategy using Plotly to communicate user behavior patterns, which enhanced client engagement by 15%. I also played a pivotal role in designing feature engineering workflows for a fraud detection system, where my Python-based solutions reduced false positives by 22%.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
My toolkit includes Python for data wrangling and machine learning, with extensive use of Pandas and NumPy for handling large datasets. I leverage Matplotlib and Plotly to create visualizations that align with business goals, and Tableau/Power BI for interactive dashboards. My MLOps expertise includes deploying models with MLflow and tracking experiments via Weights & Biases. SQL analytics form the backbone of my data exploration, enabling efficient querying of structured and semi-structured data.
